name: Ocean Swim

movements.notes: starts and finishes on the beach, around 2 buoys

origin.summary: An event from the 2016 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A 500m ocean swim starting and finishing on the beach, around two buoys.
